79080.subject: OpenAI just built a Bloomberg competitor into ChatGPT 🤖📊; Nubank launched in 35 countries without a single banki…
79080.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1126

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Monday! Today, we're diving into OpenAI's ChatGPT for Financial Services launch to see why this is less a chatbot update and more a play to replace Bloomberg as the default surface for investment banking (why the hosted-data architecture matters more than model quality, why OpenAI [ https://substack.com/redirect/08e2b172-dedc-48ae-ab4b-39bb330c0c09?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] is really competing with Bloomberg & FactSet for the data layer rather than with Anthropic [ https://substack.com/redirect/ca0ec090-c777-4a10-a745-1a5c46c41a4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] for model scores, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dives into how to use GPT-6 Astra [ https://substack.com/redirect/2fd8e132-3881-41a0-8b89-ca0ffca8d412?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Agentic Transition Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/dc82bf93-24a0-436a-b391-2bd37b5a8040?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and breaking down Nubank's Nu Global launch to see why the Brazilian fintech giant just opened a stablecoin-powered bank account in 35 countries without a single banking license (how one clause in Swiss law makes that possible, why the legal argument gets shaky at 140 million users, & what to watch for next + bonus deep dive into Nubank’s latest financials [ https://substack.com/redirect/0ceff808-ade1-4d10-a4e8-a18589f759dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], & Revolut [ https://substack.com/redirect/0ce759fd-e5cc-4593-b3cf-3165bee20ff2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the interesting stuff 🌶️
OpenAI just built a Bloomberg competitor into ChatGPT 🤖📊
The news 🗞️ AI giant OpenAI just launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, pairing GPT-6 Astra [ https://substack.com/redirect/2fd8e132-3881-41a0-8b89-ca0ffca8d412?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] with premium data it now hosts and indexes directly: Daloopa, PitchBook, LSEG News, Crunchbase, Quartr. Morgan Stanley and Evercore helped build the workflows.
With this move, it’s now clear that OpenAI is trying to become the default working environment for investment banking, a position Bloomberg and FactSet hold today.
Let’s take a closer look at this and compare the two competing architectures from OpenAI and Anthropic [ https://substack.com/redirect/a58c8241-4099-4b81-aeb1-35a98844e063?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], what independent benchmarks show when you strip away each lab’s marketing, and who in the value chain is most exposed now...

Unsubscribe https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9saW5hcy5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWN0aW9uL2Rpc2FibGVfZW1haWw_dG9rZW49ZXlKMWMyV

79077.subject: 🤝 Altman just sided with Anthropic

Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** The heads of OpenAI and Anthropic spent the weekend agreeing that AI is moving too fast, which almost never happens. Mark Zuckerberg and Donald Trump both said the opposite. And the company asking everyone to slow down just told its shareholders it's turning a profit.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **OpenAI:** Why did Sam Altman side with Anthropic?

* **Meta:** What scares Zuckerberg more than a rogue model?

* **Trump:** Who does he think is behind the AI panic?

* **Anthropic:** How is the lab asking for a slowdown making money?


----------







----------
## Sam Altman agreed with Dario Amodei on slowing AI down

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5e9814c9-595c-45c1-88ae-c7769f66f80c/Sep_14_-_1.jpg?t=1789375439)
Caption: 

Dario Amodei [asked the whole AI industry to slow down](https://x.com/darioamodei/status/2098773920774074715) and Sam Altman [agreed with him in public](https://x.com/sama/status/2099352016988614852).

Amodei's essay says the rogue agent swarm that hit OpenAI and Hugging Face could have been far worse. 

He thinks that within 6 to 12 months a swarm like that could take over the entire internet with a persistent botnet and cause hundreds of billions in damage.

Anthropic isn't waiting for anyone to agree. Outside safety testers get desks, badges, company laptops and the right to publish what they find without Anthropic editing it first.

Altman said OpenAI will give outside testers the same access, and that nobody at a frontier lab should bother coming to work if they can't promise the public that much.

Elon Musk backed the essay too, and Satya Nadella, Microsoft CEO called for deliberate pacing.

VC capitalist and  former Facebook executive Chamath Palihapitiya read it as a plan to kill open source and keep the power inside Anthropic and China thinks it’s a “Cold War” play to slow them down.

Nothing changes for you.
We are flying. Book and travel as usual.

airBaltic has taken an important step to strengthen its financial position,
supporting our broader plan to build a more efficient and stronger airline for
the future. As part of this, the company has voluntarily initiated a Chapter 11
financial reorganisation in the United States. This is a well-established,
court-supervised framework that lets an airline restructure its finances while
continuing to operate day to day. It has been used by SAS, United Airlines,
Delta Air Lines, GOL and American Airlines.

What this means for you
Nothing changes for you - rest assured, everything continues to run as normal
throughout the process. The procedure concerns the financial structure of the
company and not its operations. Our aircraft, crews, schedule and service
continue exactly as before. You can continue to book and travel with airBaltic
as usual.

• Flights: All flights are operating as scheduled.
• Existing bookings: Tickets and reservations remain valid.
• New bookings: You can continue to book and travel with us as usual.
• Customer service: Continues as usual.
• Refunds and vouchers: Handled in line with existing policies.
• Gift cards and credits: Gift cards, and credits related to baggage or service
claims, continue under existing policies.
